title: Pin retained checkpoint exclusion across automatic queue drain entry points
outcome: Existing automatic queue entry points cannot dispatch through a retained Unknown checkpoint duty, with direct controls for each supported drain owner.
acceptance: Exercise retry-attempt, capacity-resume, durability-release, boot-recovery and source-observation drain entry points against a retained original Unknown checkpoint through existing fixtures.
Assert no new control or provider dispatch, exact retained request and ledger/mirror identity, and unchanged queued ownership while the independent duty excludes admission.
Rename or extend the control-returning transient case so its name matches the recovery transition it actually exercises; preserve positive supported settlement tests.
